note: Package 12: far shots against their stored Quicksilver references, % of pixels over 8/255 (far shots: counted where the same view with far terrain off matches its reference; off shots: the whole picture). The rule (docs/ci-limits.md, Package 12): twice the largest sample, at least 0.001, rounded up to 0.0005, from three full runs; samples and runs in docs/ci-limits.md. A shot with no limit yet fails ('no limit').
